items.title: Extent of Crime Stoppers data breach unknown: Sault Police chief
items.author: Dissent
items.content: <article>James Hopkin reports: The Sault’s police chief says it’s currently unclear how many anonymous tips received by Crime Stoppers locally were potentially exposed in a massive data breach. items.title: UNM Health addresses cyberattack in New Mexico after ransomware group claims responsibility
items.author: Dissent
items.content: <article>John Rupolo reports: University of New Mexico Health is addressing concerns after a cyberattack on Monday, with reports surfacing this week that a ransomware group claimed responsibility for the incident. “So what I can say is we’re also aware of those claims by that group,” said Chris Ramirez, communications director for UNMH. items.title: Florida education department says data breach may affect 4.9 million people
items.author: Dissent
items.content: <article>Eric Weiss reports: The Florida Department of Education says a breach of its student financial aid website may have exposed personal information, including Social Security numbers, belonging to approximately 4.9 million people. The department said staff learned of unauthorized criminal access to the Florida Student Financial Aid website on Oct. 19. It activated cybersecurity response...</article>

items.title: A RIZAP Employee Uploaded 726 People’s Health Records to a Personal AI Chat

items.content: <article>Rowan Sterling reports: On 20 August 2026 an employee of RIZAP Inc., the Japanese fitness and health-guidance group, was pulling records out of the health-guidance management system it operates for insurers when the data went into a generative AI service on a personal account the company had never approved. items.title: Australia severs criminal access to 180,000 computers after breaching Amadey malware backend
items.author: Dissent
items.content: <article>Lukas Brandt writes: Criminals using the Amadey malware lost control of about 180,000 infected computers after operators from the Australian Signals Directorate (ASD) gained access to the operation’s backend and severed the connection between the controllers and the victims. “The next steps that we took were to disconnect that Amadey controller from all those victims,”...</article>

items.title: Student SSNs and Medicaid IDs Exposed in Frontline School Software Breach
items.author: Dissent
items.content: <article>Kalleigh Lane reports: If your school district used Frontline Central or School Health Management, your Social Security number, date of birth, or government ID could have been caught up in a cybersecurity incident. That risk applies to some adults and minors whose information was processed through those products. Frontline Education announced Oct. 26, 2026, that...</article>

items.title: DHS personnel leak exposes contact details and sensitive job information
items.author: Dissent
items.content: <article>David DiMolfetta reports: Searchable records identifying more than 41,000 current and former Department of Homeland Security employees and contractors were published Wednesday, exposing contact information and details about sensitive assignments across the department, according to the organizations behind the release.
